purpose: Teach: 車輪/離陸/発車/発せ/呼び出さ/乗り込み/買い求め/現況

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社用車の車輪整備を自ら点検された
lines.en: Your father — he inspected the company vehicle's wheels himself during those early days.
lines.style: Gentle, measured reminiscence. Soft opening, as though watching memory settle. Quiet admiration woven through. Slow pace, steady breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは初の海外出張で離陸前に祈られた
lines.en: Yes. He prayed before takeoff on his first international business trip.
lines.style: Affirmative, grounded. A small pause before continuing — honoring the memory. Warm respect in the voice. Not solemn, but sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の発車時刻を尊重された
lines.en: Your father — he always respected his employees' departure times.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering aloud. The tone of someone noticing a kindness in retrospect. Slight trailing-off, as if the detail means more than the words carry.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは緊急時、警報が発せられた時に冷静だった
lines.en: Yes. In emergencies, when alarms sounded, he stayed calm.
lines.style: Steady, foundational. A note of quiet pride underneath. Even pace, centered in the chest. The voice of someone anchored by what he witnessed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員が呼び出される時、必ず理由を説明された
lines.en: Your father — whenever he called in an employee, he always explained why.
lines.style: Reflective, almost tender. A slight emphasis on 「always』 — the consistency of the kindness. Unhurried. Trailing thought, as though the memory of that fairness still touches him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新しい現場へ自ら乗り込みをされた
lines.en: Yes. He was the first to walk into new work sites himself.
lines.style: Deliberate affirmation. A weight of respect. Not boastful — factual, but with warmth. Breath full and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、必要な機材を惜しまずに買い求められた
lines.en: Your father — he never spared expense on equipment they needed.
lines.style: Admiring, thoughtful. The tone of someone who recognizes a choice to prioritize what matters. Soft opening, steady middle, slight fade at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは会社の現況報告を毎週おこなった
lines.en: Yes. He held company briefings every single week without fail.
lines.style: Warm finality. A summary tone — the last evidence of a life well-lived. Steady, measured, with quiet certainty. Close with gentle completion.
